pages.title: Navi Mumbai
pages.description: Satellite city of Mumbai
pages.extract:
Navi Mumbai (Marathi: नवी मुंबई Navī Mumbaī), formerly New Bombay, is a planned city near Mumbai, India. It is a part of the Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR). It was founded in 1971, as a satellite township to take the pressure off the core city. Although it has been only partially successful in this sense, this has been changing with many IT and ITES industries setting up shop here.
This article also covers Panvel, Ulwe and Uran, which are newer cities and development nodes neighbouring Navi Mumbai.

pages.title: Andasibe-Mantadia National Park
pages.description: National park in Madagascar
pages.extract: Andasibe-Mantadia National Park is about 150 km from Antananarivo in the Toamasina Province of Madagascar.  The combined parks are perhaps best known as the home of the Indri lemurs, which is the largest surviving lemur species whose singing can be heard for miles each morning and evening.

pages.title: Townsend (Montana)
pages.description: city in Montana, USA
pages.extract: Townsend is a town in Montana. It is the county seat of Broadwater County and about 1,700 people live there. Townsend is at the southern tip of Canyon Ferry Reservoir, a year-round popular spot for boaters and fisherman.
